name: orbit-hero
description: Platform hero: copy and two buttons beside the panda holding the assistant orb, with labelled badges orbiting it and a chip strip below. Live: .apx-hero on /asset-intelligence-platform/.

title.description: Title (the page H1). Line breaks are kept.

title_accent.description: Part of the title painted with the brand gradient.

secondary_label.description: Outlined second button text. Renders only with secondary_url.

orb.description: Assistant orb image at the centre of the stage.

badges.description: Up to six orbiting badges. Each: title, note; icon (URL) or icon_svg; slot (inspect, work, assets, analytics, insights, compliance) decides where it sits.

features.description: Chips in the strip under the stage. Each: label; icon (URL) or icon_svg.
